original.statement: Between external-secrets 0.15.0 and 0.16.0 the required list for spec.provider.fake.data items in the external-secrets.io/v1beta1 SecretStore schema changed from [key] to [key,value] (the same diff shows the identical change for ClusterSecretStore), so objects that omit spec.provider.fake.data[].value are rejected.

decision.reason: [ev-210dbd3942ad] shows that from 0.15.0 to 0.16.0 the required list for the items of spec.provider.fake.data, in the v1beta1 schema of secretstores.external-secrets.io, changed from ["key"] to ["key","value"]. So spec.provider.fake.data[].value in SecretStore v1beta1 is now required, and the evidence states this only for v1beta1. The deterministic CRD and restatement validators confirm both the subject and the now-required change from the bundle CRDs [ev-9889c9b8706d, ev-e08924afdc47].
